title: Add integration tests and README for users to use the service
body:
Adds a README to explain the project to users and to guide them on successfully using it.
Also adds integration tests for thorough checking on the worker service and gRPC API.

The added integration tests pass:

```
go test -tags integration -race ./integration/     
ok      github.com/rajansandeep/teleport-job-worker-svc/integration     2.005s
```

title: Add implementation of gRPC API, mTLS, auth, server binary and cert gen
body:
Adds the gRPC server layer on top of the worker library, including the protobuf API, request handlers, and server binary. It also adds mTLS authentication, role-based authorization, and the cert-generation support needed to run the server securely.

#### Tests

Unit tests are added and the tests pass successfully:
```
go test -race  ./...
?       github.com/rajansandeep/teleport-job-worker-svc/cmd/jobworker-server    [no test files]
?       github.com/rajansandeep/teleport-job-worker-svc/gen/jobworker/v1        [no test files]
ok      github.com/rajansandeep/teleport-job-worker-svc/internal/grpcserver     1.333s
ok      github.com/rajansandeep/teleport-job-worker-svc/internal/worker 1.467s
```

title: implement core worker library
body:
implements the core in-memory worker library for starting, stopping, tracking, and streaming job output on Linux, along with worker-level unit tests.

Follows the implementation plan from the Design Document.

### Test plan
The added unit tests pass. Integration tests will be added later.

```
go test -race ./...                                                                             
ok      github.com/rajansandeep/teleport-job-worker-svc/internal/worker 1.640s
```
